There are better bars
Dec 2019
We stopped at Donkey for a drink with the tour group. The view is good from the balcony, you can see all the action on the street. The service was decent, however the music was super loud, making it difficult to have a conversation even on the balcony. 

They have a few games there, as in ping pong, pool and foosball. The foosball table is a joke, bent rods and the wrong balls used for foos. The pool table wasn’t much better, extremely warped cues, and an uneven table, that combined for several missed shots in a row. We did have some fun, however after a few drinks, we headed across the street to a better bar.

Its OK but you can do better
Apr 2019 • Solo
Oddball place, only chosen because I was down on cash and the place I originally went to didnt accept credit cards. I went to sit upstairs which has a nice open frontage looking down on the street, there's too much pollution and noise at ground level. I had the special platter consisting of various cuts of cold meats plus salad veg, which was more than enough for me, and with four happy-hour beers came to 549,780 Dong. People have written that they're over-priced and food is not great, but that was still reasonable by my standards. So, its a donkey not a thoroughbred, but donkeys have their uses.
